## Limitations

- Unattributed PATT content is used under PATT's MIT licence as an ASSUMPTION, not a verified fact; PATT has many contributors and a missing header does not prove authorship.
- The third-party deny-list is PROPOSED and was reviewed offline; no upstream licence was re-verified.
- The category tiering (primary / report-only) is PROPOSED.
- The 15 structural rules are negative and were designed on the audit sample (in-sample); the post-filter audit (spec section 7) and the blind human review (section 11.3) have NOT been run.
- label_status is PENDING_ADJUDICATION for every record; wrong-category contamination cannot be filtered structurally.
- The per-source-file cap value is PENDING (spec section 11.2); shares above 25% are reported only.
- Typographic corruption (en-dash / prime / curly quotes) and `0x`/`\x` mutation text outside the scoped categories are not detected by the 15 rules.
